mapper.insert: insert into qxx_sys_external_doc (factory_id, system_code, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, external_id, external_no, external_version, sync_status, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{factoryId}, #{systemCode}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{externalId}, #{externalNo}, #{externalVersion}, #{syncStatus}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update biz_id = #{bizId}, biz_no = #{bizNo}, external_id = #{externalId}, external_version = #{externalVersion}, sync_status = #{syncStatus}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{createBy}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select doc_id, factory_id, system_code, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, external_id, external_no, external_version, sync_status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from qxx_sys_external_doc where biz_type = #{bizType} and biz_id = #{bizId} order by doc_id asc
